crossRefs.note: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, behold, I stood on the brink of the river;

people.name: Nile
people.line: The major river of Egypt, mentioned in various contexts

translations.web: Behold, seven cattle came up out of the river. They were sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass.
translations.bsb: when seven cows, sleek and well-fed, came up from the river and began to graze among the reeds.
translations.kjv: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.
translations.asv: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, well-favored and fat-fleshed; and they fed in the reed-grass.
